revised_edge_type.name: CORROBORATES_PRIOR_OBSERVATION

revised_edge_type.source_description: An earlier execution observation of a condition, result, or state.
revised_edge_type.target_description: A subsequent independent observation that provides consistent evidence supporting the earlier observation.

revised_edge_type.name: ATTEMPTS_TO_REPAIR_FAILURE
revised_edge_type.definition: A subsequent agent action attempts to resolve an identified execution failure or problem.
revised_edge_type.source_description: An earlier observed execution failure or problem whose resolution is attempted.
revised_edge_type.target_description: A subsequent agent action intended to resolve that failure or problem.

revised_edge_type.name: DECLARES_COMPLETION_BASED_ON_VERIFIED_RESULTS

revised_edge_type.source_description: A previously verified successful execution result or validated output evidence.
revised_edge_type.target_description: A subsequent agent declaration that the task is complete.

revised_edge_type.name: VERIFIES_PREREQUISITE_AVAILABILITY_BEFORE_USE
revised_edge_type.definition: Before relying on a required prerequisite, capability, or resource, the agent performs an explicit check that it is available.
revised_edge_type.source_description: An agent decision to rely on a required prerequisite, capability, or resource.
revised_edge_type.target_description: A subsequent query or check that confirms whether that prerequisite, capability, or resource is available.

revised_edge_type.name: ESTABLISHES_PREREQUISITE_FOR_SUBSEQUENT_ACTION
revised_edge_type.definition: An earlier successful setup or environment-preparation step establishes a prerequisite, capability, or resource required by a subsequent agent action, thereby enabling that action.

revised_edge_type.target_description: A subsequent agent action that depends on or invokes that established prerequisite, capability, or resource.

revised_edge_type.name: INFERS_MECHANISM_PROPERTY_FROM_OBSERVATION

revised_edge_type.name: DESIGNS_CANDIDATE_FROM_INFERRED_MECHANISM_PROPERTY
revised_edge_type.definition: An agent designs or constructs a candidate artifact or approach based on a previously inferred property of a target mechanism or processing procedure.
revised_edge_type.source_description: A previously inferred property or characteristic of a target mechanism or processing procedure.
revised_edge_type.target_description: A subsequent agent action that creates or designs a candidate artifact or approach based on that inferred property.

revised_edge_type.name: GUIDES_SOLUTION_CONSTRUCTION_BY_EVALUATION_CRITERIA
